item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:30 HKT 25/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Although Tropical Cyclone Ragasa is departing, its outer rainbands will still bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today. With Ragasa departing further and weakening, the weather will improve with showers easing off gradually in the latter part of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bualoi over the western North Pacific will move towards Philippines and enter the South China Sea today and tomorrow. It will then move across the central and southern parts of the South China Sea in the general direction of the seas south of Hainan Island. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
